parts.note_add: The 1982 workshop manual (S-038 p.T:3) lists NS70S, 55 Ah (20 h), 12 V negative ground as the battery for an automatic car outside California; S.G. 1.280 fully charged, recharge at 1.220. A modern JIS NS70 is 259 x 173 x 223 mm with SAE taper posts; measure the tray before buying (confirm).

Figure 1850A-1 (S-005 EC p.61) shows a bar clamp across the battery top held by a hooked J-rod (clamp bolt 70985A) and nut 999400602, with the tray (56863A) on the carrier (53260) that bolts to the body with 997960612. Clamp 8871-56-030A is retired by Mazda; Atkins Rotary lists it new at USD 52, out of stock on 2026-09-25.

Per S-001 Section A the battery + post feeds the starting motor directly and, through the 1.25 sq main fusible link at X-07, the WR constant bus (ignition switch, alternator B). The A/T cable 8872-67-250B differs from the M/T one; aftermarket SMP cables are listed for 1979-85 RX-7 but none is confirmed to match the A/T routing.

S-001 shows the battery - post straight to ground; the ground point (body or engine) is not drawn, confirm on the car. Retail listing: Standard Motor Products A22-4, negative, 1979-1985 RX-7 (not checked against 8871-67-260A).
